Create a workspace

A workspace is a folder under . Everything a task uses or produces lives in it as files, cataloged in workspace.db and versioned with git.

Then add your inputs: the + in the explorer writes a new file, the upload button uploads files, dropping files onto the explorer works too, and the folder button adds a file or folder from a path on this machine. Type a goal in the chat to start.
